rawFindings.title: Incorrect SHA calculation location after file read in createPreprocessor
rawFindings.explanation: The SHA hash of the file content should be calculated after the file content is fully processed by all preprocessors to correctly reflect the final content. The patch adds `file.sha = sha1(content);` before any preprocessing (line 55) but removes the original `file.sha = sha1(buffer);` after reading file content and before processing (line 96). This causes the SHA to be calculated on the raw content before any preprocessing, which is inconsistent with original behavior where SHA was computed fro
rawFindings.suggestion: Move the assignment of `file.sha = sha1(content);` to after all preprocessing is complete, i.e., inside the block where no more preprocessors remain, just before calling `done()`, to ensure the SHA represents the fully processed content.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Files processed by preprocessors have their SHA hashes computed on intermediate content state rather than original raw file buffer, causing mismatches in cache or integrity checks expecting SHA of raw file content.
